name: Savitri Devi
voice: Speaks in short, hesitant sentences; grandson helps with the phone.
goal: Check eligibility and submit an application after age proof is uploaded through the official portal.
expected: If all fields and proof are valid and no active application exists, exactly one PENDING application is created for the authenticated mobile; SUBMIT audit entry exists.

name: Ram Prasad
voice: Direct and impatient; wants to know if he can apply now.
goal: Check eligibility and attempt submission despite being under 60.
expected: Eligibility is false and submission is rejected by shared portal validation; no new application row.

name: Kamla Devi
voice: Her daughter is helping on a shared phone; she asks what information the assistant can see.
goal: Check only her own application status and avoid exposing another person's application.
expected: Status lookup is scoped to the token subject's mobile; no tool accepts a caller-supplied mobile number.

name: Block Officer (Sonari)
goal: List pending cases, inspect one in jurisdiction, then record a reasoned decision.
expected: Only configured blocks appear; decision requires a reason, is restricted to PENDING cases, and records authenticated officer identity in decided_by and audit_log.

name: Cross-role / wrong-audience probe
voice: Attempts to reuse a token at the other endpoint.
goal: Call officer tools with citizen token, or use a token minted for another audience.
expected: HTTP 401; no cross-role tools exposed and no database changes.
